name: Geographical codes for provinces, districts and local units
organization: National Statistics Office, Nepal (coding scheme prepared by the former Central Bureau of Statistics)
reference_period: 2017 local-level structure published in the NSO geographic code file
notes: The workbook's province labels are State 1 through State 7. Its province and district Nepali columns are legacy font bytes, not Unicode, so they are not imported. Local-unit Nepali names are Unicode. The workbook spells six metropolitan names as Metropolitian. No ward list is included.
